# Psychology Today

> Psychology Today is a comprehensive mental health resource platform offering a verified therapist directory, mental health education, and wellness guidance to help users find professional support and understand psychological conditions.

Psychology Today serves as a leading digital hub connecting individuals with licensed mental health professionals across the United States. The platform combines a searchable therapist directory with educational content on mental health conditions, treatment options, and psychological wellness.

## Key Topics

- Therapist Directory
- Mental Health Services
- ADHD
- Anxiety Disorders
- Addiction Treatment
- Asperger's Syndrome
- Counseling Services
- Location-Based Search
- Therapy Specialties
- Mental Health Conditions
- Treatment Options
- Licensed Psychologists
- Counselor Finder
- Mental Wellness

## Mental Health Education & Conditions

- [Anxiety Disorders](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/anxiety): Educational reference on anxiety disorders, symptoms, and treatment options.
- [ADHD](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/adhd): Educational reference on ADHD in children and adults, symptoms, and management.
- [Addiction](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/addiction): Educational reference on addiction definition, causes, and treatment options.
- [Asperger's Syndrome](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/aspergers-syndrome): Educational reference on Asperger's Syndrome and Autism Spectrum Disorder diagnosis.
